SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to limit the number of concurrent sessions to an organization-defined number for each administrator account.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > General > Session Settings: "Maximum number of concurrent sessions" <N>. Cannot be combined with "Log Out User Due to Inactivity After" (CSNA-ND-000500); one of the two must stay 0.
FortiAnalyzer setting: Per-administrator session limit (not in the Chapter 12 map)
FortiAnalyzer command: config system admin user; edit <ADMIN>; set login-max <N>; end
FortiAnalyzer version: Not in the Chapter 12 feature map (FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 CLI Reference)

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of management information within the network device based on information flow control policies.
Cisco SNA command: Console (SystemConfig, sysadmin): Network > Trusted Hosts: list only required hosts, including the other SNA appliances. Cisco asks you to contact Cisco Support before you change the list.
FortiAnalyzer setting: Trusted hosts for administrators; Local-in policies
FortiAnalyzer command: config system admin user; edit <ADMIN>; set trusthost1 <IP> <MASK>; end and config system local-in-policy; edit 1; set intf <PORT>; set src <IP> <MASK>; set dport 443; set action accept; end

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to prohibit the use of all unnecessary and/or nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, and/or services.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > Appliance > SSH: clear "Enable SSH". Network Services > SNMP Agent: clear "Enable" if unused. Network Services > Internet Proxy: clear "Enable" if unused. General > External Services: clear "Enable Customer Success Metrics".
FortiAnalyzer setting: Interface administrative access; Disable unused analytics modules
FortiAnalyzer command: config system interface; edit <PORT>; set allowaccess https ssh; end and config system global; set disable-module <MODULES>; end

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured with only one local account to be used as the account of last resort if the authentication server is unavailable.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: User Management > Users > (Ellipsis) > Edit: keep "local" only for the admin account; "Delete" other local accounts. The built-in admin account cannot be deleted.
FortiAnalyzer setting: Individual administrator accounts. FortiAnalyzer has no setting that limits local accounts; keep one local account of last resort by procedure.
FortiAnalyzer command: config system admin user; edit <ADMIN>; set profileid <PROFILE>; set adom <ADOM>; end

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one lowercase character be used.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > General > Password Policy: "Password must contain a minimum of" 1 "lowercase letters".
FortiAnalyzer setting: Password policy. must-contain lower-case-letter; the CLS SRG asks only for an uppercase character.
FortiAnalyzer command: config system password-policy; set status enable; set minimum-length 15; set must-contain upper-case-letter lower-case-letter number non-alphanumeric; set change-4-characters enable; set expire 180; end

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one numeric character be used.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > General > Password Policy: "Password must contain a minimum of" 1 "numbers".
FortiAnalyzer setting: Password policy. must-contain number; the CLS SRG asks only for an uppercase character.
FortiAnalyzer command: config system password-policy; set status enable; set minimum-length 15; set must-contain upper-case-letter lower-case-letter number non-alphanumeric; set change-4-characters enable; set expire 180; end

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one special character be used.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > General > Password Policy: "Password must contain a minimum of" 1 "symbols".
FortiAnalyzer setting: Password policy. must-contain non-alphanumeric; the CLS SRG asks only for an uppercase character.
FortiAnalyzer command: config system password-policy; set status enable; set minimum-length 15; set must-contain upper-case-letter lower-case-letter number non-alphanumeric; set change-4-characters enable; set expire 180; end

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must use FIPS 140-3-approved algorithms for authentication to a cryptographic module.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > General > Compliance Mode: "Enable FIPS Encryption Libraries" (and the Common Criteria Encryption Libraries as the CC guide directs). Reboots the appliance; TACACS, RADIUS authentication, and External Services are then unavailable.
FortiAnalyzer command: config system fips; set status enable; end

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to terminate sessions after five minutes of inactivity and set an absolute session timeout value of eight hours or less for admin sessions, except to fulfill documented and validated mission requirements.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > General > Protected Sessions Time-Out: "Log Out User Due to Inactivity After" 5; "Request User Re-Authentication for Administrator-Only Functions After" 480. Every session ends after 12 hours (fixed); the 480-minute value only forces re-authentication for administrator functions. Cannot be combined with a concurrent-session limit (CSNA-ND-000010).
FortiAnalyzer setting: Idle session timeout. Idle timeout only; the 8.0.0 CLI Reference has no absolute session limit.
FortiAnalyzer command: config system admin setting; set idle_timeout <MINUTES>; end

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to encrypt information at rest using a DoW-accepted algorithm to protect the confidentiality and integrity of the information.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > General > Backup Configuration Encryption: "Enable Encryption"; "Backup Configuration Password". Encrypted backups have a gpg extension; the Online Help does not name the algorithm.
FortiAnalyzer command: config system backup all-settings; set status enable; set protocol sftp; set server <IP>; set user <USER>; set passwd <PASSWORD>; set crptpasswd <ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD>; end and config system global; set private-data-encryption enable; end

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must install security-relevant firmware updates within 30 days unless the time period is directed by an authoritative source (e.g., IAVM, CTOs, DTMs, STIGs).
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Central Management > Update Manager: upload the update file from Cisco Software Central; (Ellipsis) > "Install Update".
SNA version: Online Help 7.6.0; Update Guide 7.6.1 (no release history)
FortiAnalyzer setting: Firmware upgrade. Same topic as CLS SRG-APP-000456-AU-000270 under a different base requirement.
FortiAnalyzer command: execute restore image sftp <IMAGE_PATH> <SERVER_IP> <USER> <PASSWORD> (use a vendor-supported release)

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must generate audit records for modifications of critical files on the system.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > Appliance > Advanced Intrusion Detection Environment: "Enable AIDE".
FortiAnalyzer setting: No file integrity monitoring setting in the FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 CLI Reference

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to use HTTP/2 at a minimum.
Cisco SNA command: Console (SystemConfig, sysadmin): Network > HTTP Version: Yes. The appliance then rejects HTTP/1.1; do not enable it on a Manager used with the Desktop Client or Firepower Management Center.
FortiAnalyzer setting: No HTTP version setting in the FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 CLI Reference

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to obtain its public key certificates from an appropriate certificate policy through an approved service provider.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > Appliance > SSL/TLS Appliance Identity: "Update Identity", generate a CSR with "RSA Key Length" 4096 or 8192 (2048 not recommended), "Download CSR", submit to a DoD CA, "Replace Identity".
FortiAnalyzer setting: Local certificate request (not in the Chapter 12 map). The 8.0.0 CLI Reference lists key sizes up to 2048 bits; install the signed certificate with config system certificate local.
FortiAnalyzer version: Not in the Chapter 12 feature map (FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 CLI Reference)

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to implement multifactor authentication for local; network; and/or remote access to privileged accounts; and/or nonprivileged accounts such that one of the factors is provided by a device separate from the system gaining access.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: User Management > Authentication and Authorization > Create > Authentication Service > SSO: "Identity Provider Type", with an IdP that enforces multifactor authentication.
FortiAnalyzer setting: Two-factor authentication (FortiToken Cloud); PKI (certificate) administrator authentication
FortiAnalyzer command: config system admin user; edit <ADMIN>; set two-factor-auth ftc-ftm; end and config system admin user; edit <ADMIN>; set user_type pki-auth; set subject <CERT_SUBJECT>; set ca <CA_CERT>; end and config system global; set clt-cert-req enable; end

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to allow user selection of long passwords and passphrases, including spaces and all printable characters for password-based authentication.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > General > Password Policy: "Password must be at most" 32 or more (default 256); "Password must be at least" 15.
FortiAnalyzer setting: No setting; administrator passwords take up to 128 characters (8.0.0 CLI Reference, config system admin user)

SNA requirement: The Cisco SNA appliance must be configured to implement certificate revocation checking to support path discovery and validation for public key-based authentication.
Cisco SNA command: GUI: Appliance Configuration > Network Services > Audit Log Destination: "Certificate Revocation" "Hard Fail".
FortiAnalyzer command: config system certificate ca; edit <CA>; set ca <CERTIFICATE>; end and config system certificate crl; edit <CRL>; set http-url <CRL_URL>; end
